## Summary

Describe the change and why it belongs in this template.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran `python3 scripts/validate_skills.py`
- [ ] Updated the README or documentation where needed
- [ ] Used synthetic or sanitized examples only
- [ ] Kept the shared safety, fallback, and equivalence requirements intact

## For new or changed plugins

- [ ] Identified the host-owned boundaries (permissions, transactions, data access, events)
- [ ] Documented the default binding and feature-flagged fallback
- [ ] Added only framework-specific content; shared rules remain shared
